Name: Broken Lively Farmhouse
Author: amillionand1fandoms
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Using overlays, this retextures the first two levels of Lively Farmer Home. This matches the seasonal and weather based changes of the original mod. Instead of a small farmhouse that gets larger, the first two levels are already "full size" but are very beat up and damaged. See images above for how it appears in game. (Some images include the 3rd level farmhouse, but that's just how it appears in Lively Farmer Home - I haven't changed anything with it.)[/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Unlike Lively Farmer Home, Broken Farmhouse is not actually [i]required[/i] and if you just want your farmhouse to look like this but level up normally via Robin, you can do that. However, the whole reason I made this mod is because I wanted to have a cool farmhouse that fit the lore of Broken Farmhouse and I highly encourage you to check out that mod. It adds a fun series of quests that are more interesting than the vanilla upgrade process and it just makes sense that Grandpa would have a bigger house than the shack we normally start with![/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]
[b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Make sure you've installed Lively Farmer Home [i]and selected something that is NOT Starblue as your house recolor in its config[/i]. Then download this mod, unzip it, and place it into your mods folder.[/color]


[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b][u]Recolors[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]I plan to support all of the recolor options that Lively Farmer Home has, but to be honest it's not the top of my priority list. (I'm using VPR personally and I've got other mods that interest me more to make.) So if you really want [s]vanilla color, DaisyNiko's Earthy, or[/s] Starblue please tell me so in the comments and that will let me know to prioritize it more.[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Currently this has Vanilla, Earthy, and VPR versions. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][u]Custom Weather[/u][/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Since I'm using overlays, I had to specifically set the "default" for sunny and windy days so there wouldn't be weird overlaps. This [i]might[/i] mean my changes don't apply in some custom weather. Let me know if you have any issues and what modded weather caused it and I am happy to add compatibility.[/color]


[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to Alvedea for Lively Farmer Home and for allowing me to modify it to create and share this mod![/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to glymr for Broken Farmhouse, which addresses one of my little gripes with the game in a far more engaging way than I could've dreamed up![/color][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/21756069]SeraphineDreams[/url][/color] who was the first person to make this sort of farmhouse edit and explained how to make sure the chimney smoke shows up in the correct place for all the levels. If you want a different style farmhouse that also works with Broken Farmhouse, check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3163]Stone Building Mod[/url].
Thanks to SpiderButtons for CMCT, which made it possible for this mod to use the same recolor as Lively Farmer Home without extra fiddling with configs. (Once actually I finish editing the other recolors...)
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Please go and endorse all these awesome mods![/color][/size]
